steps.en: Add the Helm repo and install into kube-system
steps.zh: 加 Helm 仓库并装进 kube-system

steps.en: Serves the web UI from the cluster using the ServiceAccount
steps.zh: 用 ServiceAccount 在集群里提供网页界面

steps.en: Port-forward and open it in a browser
steps.zh: 做端口转发，用浏览器打开

steps.en: Hides edit and delete when your RBAC cannot do those verbs
steps.zh: 你没权限的编辑和删除按钮直接不显示

value.en: A shared browser UI that only offers the actions your role can actually perform
value.zh: 团队共用的浏览器界面，只给出你角色真正能做的操作

sources: https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/installation/in-cluster/ Using Helm (helm repo add headlamp …, helm install my-headlamp headlamp/headlamp --namespace kube-system)
same page Exposing Headlamp with port-forwarding (kubectl port-forward -n kube-system service/headlamp 8080:80)
https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/headlamp README Features (UI controls reflecting user roles)
